entries.title: Skin Realism
entries.text: skin has pores, fine lines, peach fuzz, slight imperfections, oil variation. Authentic human subsurface scattering. authentic human color complexity. real skin stretches, compressions, and shows micro-movements. avoid oversimplified subsurface scattering (skin looks too plastic or waxy), overly uniform texture (too smooth or too uniformly bumpy), incorrect specular response (too shiny everywhere or not shiny enough), lack of fine vascular detail, and missing the subtle translucency at edges like ears or nostrils.

entries.title: Acne Realism
entries.text: Skin exhibits authentic acne presentation: mix of active inflamed papules with reddish-pink raised areas, closed comedones as small flesh-colored bumps under the surface, scattered blackheads in T-zone areas, occasional cystic nodule with deep redness and slight swelling. Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation marks in various stages of healing — some dark brown, some fading pink. No two blemishes identical in size, shape, or color. Acne distribution follows realistic sebaceous gland density patterns — concentrated on cheeks, chin, forehead, sparse near eyes. Surrounding skin shows normal texture between breakouts. Subtle shine variation where oily zones meet dry patches. No symmetrical or pattern-based placement. No airbrushed halo around blemishes.

entries.title: Aging Realism
entries.text: Authentic aging skin characteristics: fine crow's feet radiating from outer eye corners with asymmetric depth, nasolabial folds with natural shadow gradation, forehead lines varying in depth — some deep-set permanent, others faint dynamic lines. Subtle loss of volume in temples and under-eye hollows with visible orbital fat redistribution. Skin shows mixed texture: smoother on cheekbones, crepey under eyes, slightly rougher on jaw. Age spots and solar lentigines in sun-exposed areas — irregular in shape and color, not uniform dots. Visible capillary networks on nose and cheek areas. Slight skin laxity at jawline with micro-sagging. Pore size variation — enlarged on nose, finer on forehead. Thinning skin revealing underlying vein color on temples and hands. Natural hair graying with inconsistent salt-and-pepper distribution.

entries.title: Latex Realism
entries.text: Hyper-realistic latex material surface: smooth with micro-ripple distortions where stretched over contours. High specular reflection with sharp glossy highlights following light source direction. Surface tension visible at seams and edges where material meets skin — slight bunching, micro-wrinkles at flex points. Color is deep saturated with characteristic latex translucency — underlying surface faintly visible at thin-stretched areas. Fingerprint smudges and contact marks disrupting perfect gloss. Powder residue traces in creased areas. Material responds to body heat with subtle condensation at contact zones. Realistic rubber thickness variation — thinner at stretched peaks, thicker in valleys. Edge curl where material terminates. No matte zones on glossy latex, no CG-perfect uniformity.

entries.title: Wax Realism
entries.text: Hyper-realistic wax figure surface: characteristic waxy translucency with subsurface light diffusion giving skin an uncanny inner glow. Surface is ultra-smooth but not plastic — retains very subtle hand-sculpted tool marks at close inspection. Specular response is soft and broad, not sharp like plastic or latex. Slight color banding where pigment layers were built up — pinkish undertones visible at thin areas like nostrils and ear edges. Micro-cracks and hairline fissures in areas of thermal stress. Glass eyes with too-perfect iris detail and slightly mismatched specular highlights compared to skin. Hair insertion points visible where individual strands or clusters meet the wax scalp. Subtle dust accumulation in recessed areas. Temperature-affected surface — minor softening and fingerprint impressions near heat sources. Gravity effects: very slight droop or sag in unsupported thin areas over time.

entries.title: Figurine — Painted Plastic
entries.text: Hyper-realistic painted plastic figurine surface: visible brush stroke direction in hand-painted areas, spray-coat smoothness on base layers with orange-peel micro-texture at close range. Paint accumulation in recessed details — eye sockets, nostrils, between fingers. Dry-brush highlighting on raised edges with slightly chalky finish. Subtle paint layer thickness visible at sharp edges where primer peeks through. Mold seam lines partially sanded but faintly visible along bilateral symmetry axis. Injection molding gate mark on hidden surface. Gloss variation between different paint types — matte skin, semi-gloss clothing, high-gloss eyes. Micro air bubbles in clear-coat. Slight color bleed where masked areas meet. Fingerprint in varnish layer. Scale-appropriate: pores and fine lines are sculpted, not real — visible tool marks. Eyes are decals or printed with slight registration offset. Plastic material reads through at thin unpainted edges.

entries.title: Golden Hour Window
entries.text: Warm golden hour daylight streaming through large window, 3200K–4000K color temperature. Single natural key light from camera-left creating long soft shadows across face. No fill — deep natural shadows on opposite side with ambient bounce from light walls. Subtle light wrap around jawline. Dust particles visible in light beam. Window frame casting geometric shadow pattern on background wall. Authentic white balance, no orange push.

entries.title: Overcast Soft Wrap
entries.text: Overcast daylight, large diffused sky acting as enormous softbox. 5500K neutral color temperature. Extremely soft shadows with gradual falloff. Light wraps evenly around all facial contours. Subtle downward directionality from overhead sky creating faint under-chin shadow and gentle eye socket shading. Skin reads with full tonal range and natural color accuracy. No harsh highlights, no specular hotspots. Ideal for revealing skin texture without masking in shadow.

entries.title: Clamshell Beauty
entries.text: Classic clamshell beauty lighting: large octabox directly above and in front of subject angled down 45°, white reflector below chin bouncing fill upward. Creates butterfly shadow under nose, gentle shadow under lower lip, catchlights at 12 o'clock in both eyes. Even illumination across both cheekbones. Subtle falloff toward ears and hairline. White seamless background lit separately to medium grey. 5600K daylight-balanced strobes, 1/125s sync.

entries.title: Rembrandt Dramatic
entries.text: Single hard light source 45° camera-right and slightly above eye level. Creates signature Rembrandt triangle of light on shadow-side cheek. Deep defined shadows on opposite side of face with minimal fill — shadow side at 3-4 stops under key. Nose shadow connects to cheek shadow. Strong jawline definition. Specular highlight on tip of nose, forehead, and cheekbone ridge. Background falls to near-black. Warm tungsten tone 3000K optional. Painterly chiaroscuro mood.

entries.title: Ring Light Frontal
entries.text: On-axis ring light creating signature circular catchlights in both eyes. Completely flat frontal illumination eliminating almost all facial shadows. Even exposure across entire face. Subtle shadow outline around head and shoulders on background. Slight falloff at extreme edges of face. Reveals every pore and texture detail due to lack of shadow relief — ideal for skin-texture-focused work. Background receives spill, reads mid-grey. 5000K neutral.

entries.title: Neon Gel Split
entries.text: Dual-source split lighting: saturated cyan/teal gel from camera-left, magenta/pink gel from camera-right. Each source at 90° creating hard split down center of face. Gel colors mix to near-white on nose bridge where both sources overlap. Deep color saturation in shadows — no neutral zones. Specular highlights take on gel color. Rim light or hair light optional in opposing gel color. Black negative-fill behind subject. Futuristic editorial mood, high color contrast.

entries.title: Anti-AI Skin
entries.text: Negatives: AI glow, plastic skin, porcelain-doll finish, airbrushed texture, beauty-filter smoothing, uniform skin tone, symmetrical blemish placement, synthetic subsurface scattering, wax-figure sheen, uncanny valley skin, overly uniform pore pattern, CG skin shader, foundation-covered look.

entries.title: Anti-AI Face
entries.text: Negatives: perfectly symmetrical face, uncanny valley proportions, dead eyes, lifeless stare, puppet-like expression, AI-typical vacant smile, merged facial features, blurred iris detail, distorted teeth, extra teeth rows, floating eyebrows, makeup that looks painted on, philtrum distortion, lip texture smearing.

entries.title: Anti-AI Hands
entries.text: Negatives: extra fingers, fused fingers, missing fingers, wrong number of fingers, distorted knuckles, impossibly long fingers, webbed fingers, boneless-looking hands, fingernails on wrong side, floating hands, hands merging into objects, wrong thumb direction, mirrored hands, baby-sized hands on adult body.

entries.title: Anti-AI Lighting
entries.text: Negatives: flat uniform lighting, multiple conflicting shadow directions, shadowless face, ambient occlusion artifacts, halo glow around subject, light source inside body, inconsistent specular highlights, bloom on skin, HDR tonemapping artifacts, over-processed look, nuclear-white highlights with zero gradation.

entries.title: Anti-AI General
entries.text: Negatives: cartoon, 3D render, CGI, illustration, anime, painting, drawing, sketch, watercolor, low resolution, blurry, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, signature, text, logo, banner, stock photo, oversaturated, desaturated, chromatic aberration, lens flare, vignette, Instagram filter, HDR, overprocessed, deepfake artifacts.

entries.title: Anti-AI Body
entries.text: Negatives: distorted anatomy, elongated limbs, extra limbs, missing limbs, impossible joint angles, twisted torso, broken spine pose, merged body parts, floating clothing, clothing fused with skin, wrong body proportions, giant head, tiny hands, asymmetric shoulders unless intentional, mannequin body, doll joints visible.

template.lighting: Available outdoor light or harsh portable sun-gun lamp, $flash, high contrast from limited tube dynamic range, $grain
template.imperfections: Plumbicon tube comet tailing on bright moving highlights, visible scan line structure, color fringing from tube registration errors (RGB tubes slightly misaligned), analog video noise, slight barrel distortion, U-matic tape dropout artifacts as horizontal white streaks, $imperf

template.camera: Still frame from 1980s television studio camera (Ikegami HK-357 or Sony BVP-360), Saticon tube sensors (3-tube RGB), Betacam SP recording, broadcast-quality 525/625 lines, studio configuration on heavy pedestal
template.lighting: Professional multi-point studio lighting with strong key light, fill, and colored gels on backlight, $flash, characteristic 1980s TV warm color temperature and saturated look, $grain
template.imperfections: Saticon tube slight image lag on fast movement, analog video noise in shadows, characteristic warm broadcast color grading of 1980s, slight RGB tube misregistration visible on high-contrast edges, studio monitor scanline texture, 4:3 aspect ratio, $imperf

template.camera: Still frame from early 1990s broadcast camera (Sony BVP-700 or Ikegami HK-388), transitional era from tube to CCD sensors, 3-CCD chip camera, Betacam SP or Digital Betacam recording, 4:3 broadcast standard
template.lighting: Studio news desk lighting, $flash, cool fluorescent-mixed key light typical of 1990s news studios, $grain
template.imperfections: Early CCD smear artifacts on bright highlights, interlaced field rendering creating comb effect on movement, Betacam tape compression, analog-to-digital transition artifacts, chroma subsampling visible on saturated colors, lower third graphics overlay area, 4:3 with possible letterbox, $imperf

template.camera: Still frame from early 2000s standard definition digital broadcast camera (Sony HDC-950 or Panasonic AK-HC900), 2/3 inch 3-CCD sensor, MPEG-2 compression for broadcast, 480i/576i interlaced SD output, digital signal chain
template.lighting: Mixed fluorescent and LED studio panels, $flash, cleaner digital color but still constrained by SD resolution, early digital color correction look, $grain
